binaryName.description: Unique binary name for the tool that it can be invoked from the command line (e.g. "httpx").

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the tool (e.g. "HTTPx").

interactive.description: Whether the root tool invocation opens an interactive session or prompt.

info.description: General information about the tool such as description, version, and URL.

commands.description: List of all commands and subcommands defined for this tool.

parameters.description: Flat list of all parameters across all commands and global scope.

exclusionGroups.description: Groups of parameters with mutual exclusion or required-one-of constraints.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata attached to the tool.

description.description: A brief human-readable description of what the tool does.

version.description: The version string of the tool (e.g. "1.0.0").

url.description: The homepage or documentation URL for the tool.

key.description: Unique identifier for this command within the tool.

parentCommandKey.description: Key of the parent command; used to represent subcommand nesting.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the command.

description.description: Brief description of what this command does.

interactive.description: Whether this command opens an interactive session or prompt.

sortOrder.description: Display sort position relative to sibling commands.

key.description: Unique identifier for this parameter within the tool.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the parameter.

commandKey.description: Key of the command this parameter belongs to; omit for global parameters.

description.description: Brief description of what this parameter does or accepts.

group.description: Optional grouping label for organising related parameters in the UI.

parameterType.description: Whether this is a boolean flag, a key-value option, or a positional argument.

dataType.description: The data type of the parameter's value.

isRequired.description: Whether the user must provide this parameter.

isRepeatable.description: Whether this parameter can be specified multiple times.

isGlobal.description: Whether this parameter applies to all commands rather than a single command.

longFlag.description: The long-form flag or option name (e.g. "--verbose").

position.description: Zero-based position index for positional arguments.

sortOrder.description: Display sort position relative to sibling parameters.

arraySeparator.description: Separator character used when the option accepts multiple values in one argument (e.g. ",").

keyValueSeparator.description: Separator between key and value for key=value style options (e.g. "=").

enum.description: Allowed enum choices when dataType is "Enum".

validations.description: Validation rules applied to this parameter's value.

dependencies.description: Dependencies on other parameters (requires or conflicts-with relationships).

tags.description: Arbitrary tags for categorising or filtering parameters.

values.description: The list of allowed enum choices.

allowMultiple.description: Whether the user can select multiple values at once.

separator.description: Separator character used when joining multiple selected values.

value.description: The raw value passed to the CLI for this choice.

displayName.description: Human-readable label shown to the user for this enum choice.

description.description: Description of what this enum value does or represents.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default selection when no value is provided.

sortOrder.description: Display sort position relative to sibling enum values.

key.description: Unique identifier for this validation rule.

validationType.description: The type of validation to apply.

validationValue.description: The value to validate against (e.g. the max length number, or a regex pattern).

errorMessage.description: The error message to display when validation fails.

key.description: Unique identifier for this dependency rule.

parameterKey.description: Key of the parameter that owns this dependency.

dependsOnParameterKey.description: Key of the parameter this dependency references.

dependencyType.description: Whether this parameter requires or conflicts with the referenced parameter.

conditionValue.description: Optional value that the referenced parameter must have for this dependency to apply.

key.description: Unique identifier for this exclusion group.

commandKey.description: Key of the command this exclusion group belongs to; omit for global groups.

name.description: Human-readable name for this exclusion group.

exclusionType.description: Whether parameters in this group are mutually exclusive or one is required.

parameterKeys.description: Keys of the parameters that participate in this exclusion group.
